tagline: Open a 3D model on this device. Orbit it, inspect the scene.
description:
The last model stays in the file, so you can close the app and come back still looking at it. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

Open a .glb or .gltf. Drag to orbit, pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers to pan. The panel lists meshes, materials, cameras and clips — tap a row to flash that object. Play a clip if the file has one. Switch wireframe, a floor grid, skeleton, or a slow auto-rotate. Lighting is a local studio; no sky is fetched from anywhere.

On a phone the inspect sheet folds under the view so the model keeps the screen. One finger orbits, a pinch zooms.

Press Invite in the bar above and a friend sits with you. Each of you opens a file on your own device; the model is not sent.

An unofficial port of Don McCurdy's glTF Viewer. Same job: open a model, look at it. This copy keeps the file here and leaves the remote sky maps behind.
